description: Proposed lower ground and upper ground floor glazed rear extension, outbuilding and ASHP
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>A scheme for the provision and implementation of flood-resilient and resistant construction details
and measures for the site and in the basement against surface water (overland flow) flood risk
shall be submitted to and agreed, in writing with the LPA in consultation with the LLFA prior to the
construction of the measures. The scheme shall be carried out in its entirety before the basement
is occupied and; constructed and completed in accordance with the approved plans in line with
BS 8102:2022 Protection of below ground structures against water ingress - code of practice and
current best practice where applicable.</p><p>Reason: In the interest of drainage</p>

<p>Full details, including physical samples, of all the materials to be used on the external surfaces of the building, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, before any work commences on site. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Sections 16 and 66 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework, December 2024, Paragraphs 202 to 221; The London Plan 2021 Policy HC1 Heritage conservation and growth; and Hackney Local Plan 2033, Policies LP1 Design Quality and Local Character, LP3 Designated Heritage Assets.</p><p><br></p>

<p>A post installation noise assessment report that demonstrates the noise levels
from the Mitsubishi PUZ-WM60VAA unit when running shall be 10dB(A) or more below the
background noise level (daytime), and no more than 33dBLAeq (night time), when
measured at 1m from any nearby noise sensitive premises at any time.</p><p>The assessment of the expected noise levels shall be carried out by a suitably qualified (IOA accredited) and experienced acoustic consultant, in accordance with BS 4142:2014+A1:2019 ‘Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound,’ and any mitigation measures necessary to achieve the above required noise levels shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval. The plant shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details.</p><p>Reason: To protect acceptable local noise levels.</p>

<p>The planting of the black mulberry tree, as explicitly detailed and located at the rear of the garden on the approved Ground Floor Plan (drawing no. 311_P_111_00) and drawing no. 311_P_112_03, shall be carried out in the first planting season following the occupation of the development or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. The new tree must be at least light standard size (6-8 cm girth).&nbsp; If within a period of five years from the date of the planting, the black mulberry tree (or any tree planted in replacement for it) is removed, uprooted, destroyed, dies, or becomes, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously damaged or defective, another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place within the next planting season, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its written consent to any variation.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To ensure the site protects and enhances biodiversity, in accordance with LP47 and LP51 of the Hackney Local Plan.</p>

<p>Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management &amp; maintenance plan (where applicable) of the water butt with overflow and living roof (substrate depth of 80-150mm excluding the vegetative mat) shall be submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume.</p><p>Reason: In the interest of drainage</p>
